title: Install the check in a repository you own
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Add the check workflow to a repository you own and let it finish once on a pull request.
evidence: a repository your account owns whose default branch calls the public pinned check workflow, and one finished run of it
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
